name: SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT (and TailSteer)

lineage.how_derived: NEO-unify native unified multimodal architecture, Qwen3 LLM component per config; U1.5 strengthens patchify layers, data, task formulation, prompt enhancement and post-training (card)

purpose: Native unified multimodal model for visual creation: higher-quality image generation, text rendering and infographics, efficient native 4K, reliable image editing, complex-instruction following and region-level control (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag and badge say Apache 2.0; repo LICENSE not opened.

architecture.kind: unified autoregressive/diffusion multimodal model with a Qwen3 text backbone (NEOChatModel, custom code), mixture-of-transformers (MoT)

variants.notes: repo total per HF API (BF16 weights are about 16 GB per the 8B name; remainder not itemised)

pc-12gb.notes: 16.0 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: 16.0 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.notes: 16.0 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 16.0 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 16.0 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: llama.cpp b11801 'model: Add support for SenseNova U1 model' (2026-10-21).

strengths: image generation and editing in an 8B model with GGUF community builds
weaknesses: benchmark results are images in the card; no numbers extracted

tona_fit.reason: One 8B model for image generation, editing and understanding is attractive for the 16 GB class, and llama.cpp now loads the architecture; unverified quality, so compare with Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo and Z-Image-Turbo first.

open_questions: Exact parameter count and VRAM use for 4K generation
